status_rule: After completing a task, set its check field to true. In future runs, only tasks with check false are eligible for work.
scope: Add a locally saved Settings panel to the main page. It provides theme mode, five accent-color presets, and free-font selection without changing viewer behavior, question data, or mathematical/code typography.
assumptions: The default theme is the current blue accent with system-preference color mode.
Settings are stored only in the browser localStorage and are not sent to a server or written to problem JSON files.
The initial accent presets are red, yellow, green, blue, and purple.
The initial font choices are system default, Pretendard, Noto Sans KR, and Gowun Dodum.
Theme and font controls are accessed through a main-page Settings button, with theme and font as subitems.
MathJax expressions and fixed-width code/JSON regions retain their existing font rules.

tasks.title: Identify main-page accent and typography targets
tasks.summary: Map existing buttons, sliders, selected-file styling, and help icons so the settings implementation changes only the intended visual elements.
verify: List each intended accent target and its current selector.
Confirm no question data or viewer logic is in scope.

tasks.title: Define light and dark theme tokens
tasks.summary: Create semantic variables for surfaces, text, borders, accent color, accent contrast text, hover, focus, and selected-file styling.
verify: Light and dark modes both use readable text, surface, and border colors.
Accent variables cover the listed targets without hard-coded per-preset component colors.

tasks.title: Add Settings button and settings panel
tasks.summary: Place a Settings button on the main page and expose Theme and Font subitems in a compact panel.
verify: Panel can be opened and closed by mouse and keyboard.
Each setting control has an associated accessible label.
Existing main-page controls remain usable.

tasks.title: Implement mode and five accent presets
tasks.targets: index.html theme control logic and CSS
tasks.summary: Support system, light, and dark modes plus red, yellow, green, blue, and purple accents; blue remains the default and yellow uses sufficient text contrast.
verify: Each of five presets visibly updates buttons, sliders, selected files, help icons, and focus/selection indicators.
System mode follows the browser preference.
Yellow preset retains readable foreground contrast.

tasks.title: Implement free-font selection
tasks.targets: index.html font loading and font-setting logic
allowed_fields: webfont references or local font assets
tasks.summary: Allow selection among system default, Pretendard, Noto Sans KR, and Gowun Dodum for general UI text only.
verify: Each font selection changes general UI text.
Math expressions and fixed-width code/JSON regions remain unchanged.
Selected font has an available fallback if its webfont cannot load.

tasks.title: Persist local preferences and add reset
tasks.summary: Save mode, accent, and font preferences in localStorage and restore them before the interface is shown; provide a reset to system mode, blue accent, and system font.
verify: Preferences survive a page reload in the same browser.
Reset restores all three defaults and updates persisted values.
No user content or JSON file is modified.

tasks.title: Verify settings behavior and visual regression
tasks.summary: Test every option combination at representative viewport sizes and confirm existing main-page workflow still works.
verify: Test system, light, and dark modes with all five accent presets.
Test all four font choices and the reset action.
Confirm keyboard navigation and focus visibility.
Confirm file selection and page navigation still work.
Parse the final checklist JSON and ensure the filename completed count matches task states.
